name: FALCO 三火 T912 / 寰宇单车 multi-configuration lead
why_interesting: Official, mainland and public brand-account evidence consistently identifies T912 / 三火, removing the earlier T91 ambiguity; the retained price range spans frameset, mechanical, mixed and electronic builds.

facts.frame_material: Carbon-fiber T912 frameset; exact grade is not consistently established across primary and mainland sources
facts.frame_construction: Triathlon/time-trial platform with six sizes, integrated hydration/storage options and disc-brake complete-build configurations
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model numeric stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent assessment was found across the 50-area sweep

missing: Exact selected configuration/SKU, drivetrain, wheelset and complete weight
Maximum tire clearance and consistently attributable carbon grade
Meaningful stiffness evidence, exact domestic warranty issuer, seller authority and final checkout price
source_note: Exact sources consistently use FALCO / 三火 T912. Current mainland indexes expose frameset, mechanical, mixed 105/BluePrint, R7170, R8170 and Dura-Ace-labeled choices, so no single drivetrain or 10.5 kg reference is assigned to the retained CNY 9,860–32,080 range.
